mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.PROD_ID)) FROM objRec A INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB B ON(A.PROD_ID = B.PRODID AND B.STATUS IN ('01','02')) WHERE TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(B.HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT prdRegistCode, prodId, prdVDate, holdDate, prdRaiseTotalQty, prdRaiseTotalAmt, investRaiseTotalQty, investRaiseTotalAmt FROM( SELECT tmp1.REG_CODE prdRegistCode, tmp1.PROD_ID as prodId, tmp1.VDATE prdVDate, TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') AS holdDate, NVL(tmp1.RAISE_QTY,0) as prdRaiseTotalQty, NVL(tmp1.TOTAL_AMT,0) as prdRaiseTotalAmt, SUM(NVL(QTY,0)) as investRaiseTotalQty, SUM(NVL(CNY_AMT,0)) as investRaiseTotalAmt FROM( SELECT A.PROD_ID, A.VDATE, A.RAISE_QTY, A.TOTAL_AMT, CASE WHEN B.STATUS = '03' THEN 0 ELSE B.CNY_AMT END CNY_AMT, CASE WHEN B.STATUS = '03' THEN 0 ELSE B.QTY END QTY, D.REG_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by A.PROD_ID , B.INDENTIFY_MARK ORDER BY B.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) AS investStatusNo FROM objRec A LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE D ON A.PROD_ID = D.PRODID INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB B ON A.PROD_ID = B.PRODID WHERE TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(B.HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') ) tmp1 WHERE investStatusNo = 1 GROUP BY tmp1.PROD_ID, tmp1.REG_CODE, tmp1.VDATE, tmp1.RAISE_QTY, tmp1.TOTAL_AMT ) tmp2 WHERE investRaiseTotalQty > 0 AND investRaiseTotalAmt > 0
